title: there was not a dry eye in the room during this part of the book read...
transcript: This is my favorite part of the book. I often reflect on all the wonderful moments and relationships I would have missed out on had I let my hopelessness consume me. No matter what you're going through, dear reader, if you're listening, no matter how dark it gets, you must carry on. You must ask for help. The burden you hold today won't be yours forever. Let me be a living testimony that the love that is available to you is well worth every second you suffered. And though I wouldn't wish what I've been through on my worst enemies, I would walk through the fire 10 times over to experience the peace and love I have today on the other end of all of it. I'm actually thankful for what I went through, Toya. I made it all worthwhile. There is so much life to live, endless love to give and receive, and oh, so much joy to be found. You are loved. Your life is precious. Love is worth living for. Hold on tight, get the help you need. And please believe me when I say you will be alright. More than alright. All with your time. Thank you.
classificationReason: The transcript is a person reading an emotionally supportive passage from a book about perseverance and mental health. There is no reference to any stage production whatsoever.
